# compliance verdict

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:complianceVerdict`](gmeow-complianceVerdict.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/complianceVerdict>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The assessor's verdict, reusing the [`EvaluationVerdict`](../classes/gmeow-EvaluationVerdict.md) vocabulary: held = compliant, not held = violative, undetermined = undetermined. Functional and mandatory (SHACL).
